fund_vision_xbrl.title: Quarterly revenue & profit: XBRL store vs PDF (vision) read
fund_vision_xbrl.reader_b: vision_fills.json — model read of the filing PDF
fund_vision_xbrl.scope: Nifty 500 members at quarter-end; quarters where both readers hold the same basis

fund_pbt_tax.title: Stored profit vs the filing's own PBT − tax
fund_pbt_tax.reader_b: fin/<SYM>.json x: PBT, tax, associates, minority (NSE XBRL detail lines)
fund_pbt_tax.scope: Nifty 500 members at quarter-end, quarters with PBT and tax filed
fund_pbt_tax.tolerance: any presentation within 2 % or Rs 1 cr

fund_eps_shares.title: Stored profit vs the company's EPS × shares outstanding
fund_eps_shares.reader_b: fin x eps_b (company-computed basic EPS) × shares_history (SHP share count at quarter-end)
fund_eps_shares.scope: Nifty 500 members at quarter-end, quarters with basic EPS and a share count
fund_eps_shares.tolerance: within 5 % or Rs 1 cr (weighted vs period-end shares)

mcap_shares.title: Market cap: BSE figure on the dashboard vs our shares x NSE close
mcap_shares.reader_b: shares_outstanding.json (SHP filing) x latest NSE close (live bin)
mcap_shares.tolerance: within 3 % (share count as of the last SHP filing)

shp_neighbours.title: Shareholding: each quarter's FII / DII vs the same company's filings either side
shp_neighbours.reader_b: the company's own previous and next quarterly filings
shp_neighbours.scope: Nifty 500 members at the quarter, 2001 → latest; the first filing of each quarter
shp_neighbours.tolerance: flag when > 3.0 pp from both neighbours while they agree within 1.5 pp
shp_neighbours.calibration: 2026-09-28: of the 50 company-quarters that the Quantmac v4 comparison showed to be ours (our value off our own neighbours, theirs on them), this screen flags 12 - errors under 3 pp and alternating series (DEN 2018) slip through. A same-company test is a candidate list, not an outside reader.

idx_levels.title: Index closes: NiftyTrader / Yahoo feeds vs niftyindices archive vs NSE daily
idx_levels.scope: Nifty 50 2002+, Nifty 500 2012+, Nifty Bank 2012+: every month-end and every shared daily close

flows_month.title: FII/DII cash flows: daily rows summed per month vs the monthly series
flows_month.reader_a: fii_dii.json daily net (NiftyTrader; NSE for the latest day)
flows_month.scope: complete months covered by the daily file
